summary: This bill establishes a loan repayment program for mental health professionals who agree to work in mental health professional shortage areas for up to six years, offering up to $250,000 in loan repayment.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses a shortage of mental health professionals by providing loan repayment incentives for service in underserved areas. This aims to improve access to mental healthcare, which is a component of public healthcare access.

The bill authorizes $25 million annually for 10 years in new federal spending for a loan repayment program without any offsetting revenue or cuts, directly increasing outlays and thus contributing to larger deficits to fund this priority.

The core purpose of the bill is a new federal loan repayment program to expand the supply of mental health professionals in shortage areas, constituting direct government intervention to improve access and lower effective costs of care.
